description.value:
Bad Eden Heritage (v1.1, RFI-native). Echo-Diver heritage: Tellurian.

“Stone doesn’t hurry. You don’t either.”

Echo-Diver (Tellurian). Your time-sense tilts toward the unchanging. You see what endures. In a room about to collapse, you are the one who can tell which beam will hold. Tellurian Echo-Divers outlast the world by refusing, at a very deep level, to be in a hurry about it.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Echo-Diver).

  • Size. Medium.

  • Movement. 6 squares walking.

  • Lineage Lean. Echo-Diver does not grant fixed attribute bonuses; your background handles increases. Your heritage leans toward Body in fiction and through Tier powers.

Echo-Diver Core: Half-Second Inheritance

Shared across all Echo-Diver heritages. Granted at character creation via the base ancestry item.

  • Temporal Flinch. You cannot be surprised while conscious. Once per scene, when you or an ally within 2 squares would be hit by an attack you can see, you can use your reaction to shift yourself or that ally 1 square If this moves the target out of the attack's range or line, the attack misses.

  • Niche Survivor. You need roughly half the food, water, and air that a comparable Medium creature needs. You reroll the lowest die on Body checks against suffocation, starvation, dehydration, and extreme temperature.

  • Vault Sight. You have low-light vision out to 12 squares You reroll the lowest die on Mind (Perception) checks to notice unstable structure, active traps, trigger plates, load-bearing failure, and temporal or Spark residue.

  • Rat Inheritance. You can squeeze through spaces at least one foot wide without halving your movement, and you can hold stillness that shouldn't work.

Tellurian Traits

  • Bedrock Resistance. You have resistance to electrical damage with the fire flavor, poison damage, and kinetic damage with a single chosen flavor at creation (bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing). The mountain has been set on fire, poisoned, and hit with very large rocks. It is still the mountain.

  • Slow Blood. You reroll the lowest die on Body checks to maintain concentration on a power or manifestation. You do not age naturally while conscious.

Strategic Hooks (Foundry / Bad Eden)

  • OP Edge. Your faction gains +2 Body OP and +1 Logistics OP at campaign start.

  • Hex Synergy. In Bedrock / Mountain / Stone-Founded hexes, your faction's defensive emplacements gain +1 on their defense track.

  • Patience Tax. Once per Strategic Turn, your faction may declare a single long-held position and gain +2 on any check to hold that position this Turn. The stone does not have plans; it has presence.

⟁ Per-Use Ability — Temporal Flinch Recovery: 1/scene  ·  Action: Reaction  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke. When an attack would hit you or an ally within 2 squares, shift them 1 square If that breaks range/LoS, the attack misses.
